name: saleads-automation
description: Automatización QA con Playwright, BDD Gherkin y POM - Saleads.ai

scripts.test: cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js --format progress-bar --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --import support/env.js --import support/world.js --import support/hooks.js --import step-definitions/login.steps.js & npx allure serve allure-results
scripts.test:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js --import support/env.js --import support/world.js --import support/hooks.js --import step-definitions/login.steps.js
scripts.test:ver: cross-env HEADLESS=false PAUSE_AFTER_SECONDS=15 cucumber-js --import support/env.js --import support/world.js --import support/hooks.js --import step-definitions/login.steps.js
scripts.test:report: npm run test:headless && npx playwright show-report report/playwright
scripts.test:allure: cucumber-js --format progress-bar --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --import support/env.js --import support/world.js --import support/hooks.js --import step-definitions/login.steps.js & npx allure serve allure-results
scripts.test:allure:ver: cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js --format progress-bar --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --import support/env.js --import support/world.js --import support/hooks.js --import step-definitions/login.steps.js & npx allure serve allure-results
